items.english: It goes under mulch to fruit trees, never onto morogo you eat raw, and kitchen or nappy water never goes in it.
items.afrikaansBefore: en kombuis- of doekwater gaan nooit daarin nie.
items.afrikaansAfter: en kombuiswater of luierwater (water waarin doeke gewas is) gaan nooit daarin nie.
items.problem: "doekwater" reads as dishcloth or cloth-washing water, so a farmer may not see that water from washing nappies (faecal contamination) must never go into greywater.

items.english: **Grit**, small hard stones or coarse sand she keeps in her gizzard to grind food
items.afrikaansBefore: - **Gruis**, klein harde klippies of growwe sand wat sy in haar krop hou om kos fyn te maal
items.afrikaansAfter: - **Gruis**, klein harde klippies of growwe sand wat sy in haar spiermaag hou om kos fyn te maal
items.problem: "krop" is the crop, not the gizzard, so the draft names the wrong organ for grinding food (factual error, low risk).
